common.notConfigured: Configure the server in Settings first

monitor.emptyDesc: Enter your server address and token in Settings to begin.
monitor.confirmStop: Stopping cannot be undone. Stop the print?

control.confirmHome: Homing moves the toolhead. Running it mid-print will ruin the current part. Continue?
control.gcodeNote: Raw G-code is disabled by default. Set ALLOW_RAW_GCODE=true on the server to enable it.
control.maxHint: Up to {max}℃. Setting 0 turns heating off.

files.note: Imported files land in the root of the printer's SD card. Timelapse and recordings are written by the printer itself.
files.modelNote: Preview and figures come from the sliced file. The mesh itself is not loaded.
files.pickSlotFirst: Assign a slot to every filament first

check.filamentLow: {slot} has about {left} g left; this plate needs {need} g
check.nozzleMismatch: Sliced for a {want} mm nozzle; the printer has {have} mm
check.printerBusy: The printer is {state} and cannot start a new job
check.noSdCard: No SD card detected in the printer
check.notSliced: This is an unsliced model; the printer only accepts sliced .gcode.3mf files.

slice.bed_temperature_too_high_than_filament: Bed temperature is above what this filament tolerates
slice.object_outside: A model extends outside the printable area
slice.toolpath_outside: Toolpath extends outside the printable area
slice.nozzle_hrc_checker: Filament is harder than this nozzle tolerates
slice.filament_is_not_compatible: Filament is not compatible with this printer

files.title: Files

settings.serverNote: Tailscale MagicDNS name with a real Let's Encrypt certificate. Credentials stay on this device.
settings.clearDesc: This removes the address and token stored on this device.
settings.footer:
Bambu Lab P2S remote monitor
End-to-end encrypted over Tailscale. No cloud service in the path.
settings.pushTestNone: No sink delivered — check the bridge push config
settings.pushInstallDesc: iOS only allows notifications from apps added to the Home Screen. In Safari tap Share → Add to Home Screen, then open this page from the icon.
settings.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support web push
settings.pushInsecure: Push requires HTTPS — use the Tailscale https address
settings.pushNoVapid: The bridge has no VAPID keys, so web push is unavailable
settings.pushDenied: Notification permission denied — allow it in system settings
settings.pairDesc: Scan with a phone camera to open the app with the address and token filled in.
settings.pairWarn: This code works like a login — only share it with people you trust.

import.fromFileHint: Pick a sliced .gcode.3mf from this device
import.fromLinkHint: The bridge downloads it — no mobile data used
import.note: The printer can only print sliced .gcode.3mf. Raw STL/STEP must be sliced on a computer first.
import.fromMwHint: Sign in, then paste a link or pick from your collection

del.title: Delete file
del.desc: This permanently removes “{name}” from the printer's SD card.

print.title: Start printing?
print.desc:
About to print “{name}”, plate {plate}.

The printer will start heating and moving immediately. Check that filament is loaded, the bed is clear, and someone can watch the first layer.
print.risk: Starting a print remotely means it runs unattended. Judge the risk yourself.

slice.title: Slice
slice.desc: Slice "{name}" into a printable file on the bridge, keeping the model’s own print settings — layer height, infill and supports stay as the author tuned them. The original is kept; the result is saved as .gcode.3mf.
slice.hint: This model is not sliced, so the printer cannot read it. Slice it first.
slice.unavailable: This bridge has no slicer installed yet.
slice.paramsNote: Defaults come from the model author. Changed rows get a dot; everything else is left untouched.
slice.paramsChanged: Only the dotted rows are overridden — the rest still slice with the author’s settings.
slice.descChanged: Slice "{name}" with your changes; everything you did not touch keeps the author’s settings. The original is kept; the result is saved as .gcode.3mf.

dry.title: Filament drying
dry.confirmStart:
Dry at {t}℃ for {h} hours.

The AMS will heat continuously. Check that only filament you want dried is inside.

blocker.printing: A print job is in progress
blocker.filamentLoaded: Filament is still in the extruder

dry.confirmUnload: This retracts the filament from the extruder back into the AMS. The nozzle heats to 210℃ first, which takes about a minute.
dry.confirmStopPrint: Stop the current print? It cannot be resumed.
dry.note: Without the AMS power adapter, drying only runs when the printer is idle and no filament is loaded.

err.title: Printer errors
err.hmsNote: HMS entries describe a condition that is still true and cannot be dismissed manually — the printer withdraws them once the condition is resolved.
err.reprintMissing: File not found — it may have been deleted from the printer

history.title: Print history
history.unweighed: {n} job(s) had no filament figure and are not counted
history.noCurve: No temperature data for this job
history.curveFailed: Could not load the temperature curve
history.noEvents: No events recorded for this job

stage.54: Waiting for the bed to reach temperature
stage.58: Thermal preconditioning for the first layer
stage.63: Waiting for chamber temperature to equalize
stage.68: Moving the toolhead over the purge chute
stage.70: Moving the toolhead to the bed centre
stage.74: Checking the bed surface for debris
stage.75: Checking under the bed for debris

harvest.title: Harvest
harvest.tooHot: Bed is still warm — needs to be under {max}℃
harvest.tooHotHint: A warm part stays stuck; forcing it only loads the hotend
harvest.confirm:
Start the harvest? The toolhead homes first, then pushes the part off the plate.
This is experimental — stay by the machine and be ready to cut power.
harvest.autoOn: Armed — it will run when this print ends
harvest.autoHint: Fans come on first; it waits for the bed to reach {t}℃. One-shot.
harvest.busyHint: A print is running, so you can only arm it for later
harvest.expAuto: This path has not been verified on a real machine
harvest.nothing: Nothing on this plate to push
harvest.fileDesc: Writes the eject sequence into this plate’s end G-code and saves it as "{name}". Print that file and the parts are pushed off the bed once it has cooled. The original is untouched.
harvest.fileNone: Nothing on this plate can be pushed
harvest.hotInfo: The bed is still warm. Pressing this turns the fans on; the bridge waits for {t}℃ and then pushes. No need to stay.

harvestWarn.tooFlat: Part is too short for the nozzle to reach
harvestWarn.noApproachRoom: Part sits too far back — the head cannot get behind it
harvestWarn.mayTipOver: Tall and narrow; it may tip instead of sliding
harvestWarn.alreadyAtEdge: Already near the front edge, so the stroke is short
harvestWarn.homingHazard: Homes first. The Z probe point avoids every part
harvestWarn.hasBrim: Has a {width}mm brim. A brim tethers the part — measured, it does not come off
harvestWarn.mayRotate: Long and narrow ({width}×{depth}mm); it may spin in place
harvestWarn.tooTallForGantry: {maxZ}mm tall — over {limit}mm hits the gantry rod
harvestWarn.noSafeHomePoint: No homing spot clears every part, so this cannot run

skip.title: Skip parts
skip.expTitle: Experimental — not yet verified on a real machine, use with care
skip.intro: A skipped part is never printed again; it stays on the plate unfinished until the job ends. The rest print as normal.
skip.confirm:
This cannot be undone: skipped parts stop printing and stay on the plate unfinished until the job ends. The other parts continue as normal.
This is experimental and has not been verified on a real machine.
skip.allHint: Can't skip every remaining part — that is a stop, use Stop instead
skip.none: Nothing on this plate can be skipped
skip.sent: Sent — the printer will skip the selected parts
skip.unsupported: This plate was sliced without object labels, so parts can't be skipped individually

check.note: Downloads each file and verifies checksums, about a minute. The bridge also runs this daily while the printer is idle and notifies you about newly found corrupt files.
check.deleteManyDesc: Delete these {n} corrupt files? They can no longer print correctly.

schedule.title: Schedule print
schedule.note: Starts printing "{name}" at {time}. Runs exactly the same preflight as a manual start; if it fails, nothing starts and you get a notification.
schedule.tooSoon: Must be at least one minute from now.

queue.title: Print queue
queue.expTitle: Experimental: the queue starts the next job unattended and has not been fully verified on real hardware. Use with care.
queue.note: Each job is harvested when it finishes; jobs whose harvest plan has warnings stop afterwards and wait for you. Starts run the same preflight as a manual start; a failed check skips the item.

reason.foreign: A print outside the queue is running
reason.blocked: Printer is not ready to continue

reasonHint.safety: The last part has been pushed off the bed. Check the photo and make sure nothing is left on the plate before resuming — otherwise the next job prints on top of the leftovers.
reasonHint.failed: The last job failed to start or failed while printing. Fix the problem, then resume; the queue continues with the next item.
reasonHint.manual: The next job will not start after the current one finishes. Resume to continue automatically.
reasonHint.foreign: Someone started a print outside the queue. Wait for it to finish and clear the bed before resuming.
reasonHint.blocked: For example the bed did not cool down in time. Make sure the printer is ready before resuming.

queue.howToAdd: Open a sliced file and tap "Add to queue" to line it up here.

mw.title: MakerWorld
mw.needTfa: Two-factor authentication is on — enter the code from your authenticator
mw.loginHint: Your password is only used to obtain a login token from Bambu Lab and is never stored; the bridge keeps only the token. Accounts that sign in with Google / Apple should use Email code. Global site (makerworld.com) only.
mw.logoutDesc: The login token stored on the bridge will be deleted.
mw.noFavorites: No models in your collection yet
mw.noProfiles: This model has no print profiles; download the raw files on the website instead
mw.importHint: Uses one of your daily MakerWorld downloads. Profiles made for another printer are converted when you slice them on the Files tab.

err.auth: Your MakerWorld session expired — please sign in again
err.captcha: MakerWorld wants a human check: download any model once on makerworld.com, solve the captcha, then try again
err.limit: This account has reached today's download limit — try again tomorrow
err.badLink: That doesn't look like a MakerWorld model link
err.cnRegion: That is a MakerWorld China link; only the global site is supported
err.codeExpired: The code expired — request a new one
err.upstream: Can't reach MakerWorld — try again later

mw.loginRowSub: Browsing is open; importing to the printer needs an account
mw.searchPh: Search models, or paste a MakerWorld link

setup.title: Setup
setup.introLead: Just a few steps. Have these three things ready:
setup.prep1: The printer is on the same network as this server
setup.prep2: Turn on LAN Mode and Developer Mode
setup.prep2Sub: On the printer screen: Settings → Network → LAN Mode. Turn it on, then turn on "Developer Mode".
setup.prep3Sub: It is on the Settings → Network → LAN Mode page; you will need it next.
setup.lanNote: In LAN Mode the printer stops talking to Bambu Cloud: remote viewing and cloud printing in Bambu Handy stop working. Bambu Studio can still print over the LAN.
setup.searching: Looking for printers on your network…
setup.noneFound: No printers found. Your router may be blocking LAN broadcasts — entering it by hand works just as well.
setup.serialHint: Both the IP and the serial number are in the printer's on-screen settings; the serial is also on the label at the back.
setup.codeHint: The 8 characters shown under Settings → Network → LAN Mode on the printer.
setup.doneLead: This device is connected and ready to use.
setup.scanSub: Scan this with your phone camera to open the app already signed in. On iPhone, tap Share → Add to Home Screen to get notifications.

err.auth: Wrong Access Code. Check the 8 characters on the printer screen.
err.unreachable: Can't reach this printer: wrong IP, or it isn't on the same network as the server.
err.noReport: Connected, but the printer isn't reporting: wrong serial number, or Developer Mode is off.
err.invalid: Invalid format: the Access Code is 8 letters or digits.
err.limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
err.done: This server is already set up.
err.restart: The service took too long to restart. Wait a moment and reload; if it persists, restart the container.

slicer.installDesc: The bridge downloads the Linux build from BambuStudio's official GitHub releases and verifies it. Then you can slice right from your phone.
slicer.sizeHint: About {dl} MB to download, about {disk} MB on disk once unpacked.
slicer.removeDesc: Deletes the downloaded copy and frees about 540 MB. You can download it again any time.
slicer.note: Unsliced models (such as MakerWorld downloads) must be sliced before printing. Once installed, files get a Slice action.
slicer.unsupportedNote: BambuStudio ships Linux builds for x86_64 only, so ARM machines like a Raspberry Pi cannot slice. Slice on a computer and upload instead.
